feature: Bounded Vultr catalog pagination and DigitalOcean response/creation validation

publication_gates.cloudflare_transport_fleet_no_skip: 201 named tests with isolated PostgreSQL, pinned native core and race detector on an independent runner
publication_gates.account_edit_mobile: six providers, four viewports, unchanged optional choices and cross-dialog settings submit
publication_gates.database_backup_regressions: 25 bootstrap, owned-cluster and backup tests; real Ubuntu install/reinstall must verify checksums
publication_gates.dispatcher_retention: Completed account churn releases identity state; cancellation and sibling completion preserve active reservations
publication_gates.migration_history: NULL/empty legacy checksums sealed; unchanged startup is idempotent; altered files rejected without replay or retained-row changes
publication_gates.recovery_lifecycle_isolation: 20 consecutive independent-fixture passes with the existing 10-second discovery deadline; any failed repetition blocks publication
publication_gates.provider_response_bounds: Native Vultr cursors, fixed endpoints, cancellation and pagination bounds; DigitalOcean bounded single-value responses and unknown creation outcomes without identity
publication_gates.ambiguous_compute_outcome: Explicit ambiguous result without identity remains UNKNOWN before success-ID validation; resumption reconciles without another create

notes: Existing single-region AWS credentials retain their original identity and region boundaries.
Additional regions are explicit, capped at four, and independently validated; partial inventory is never returned as success.
AWS Price List rates require pricing:GetProducts and cover Linux shared On-Demand compute only; EBS, IPv4, transfer, CPU credits and taxes are extra.
No production policies or saved account settings are changed by this source update.
Discovery has one None option per optional region, disables already selected regions and clears stale subnet choices before another preview.
Account preview reports bounded progress, preserves entries on failure, and keeps Save visible but disabled until validation and required network approval complete.
No additional cloud resources are created for this release verification; existing user scheduling remains authoritative.
OpenAI API review is not claimed without recorded response usage.

A forwarded installation declares DOB_PUBLIC_PANEL_PORT in root-owned service configuration. The public address is displayed separately; direct changes to its internal listener are rejected. Public gateway port editing requires an available gateway management adapter and is not implemented by this release.
Control recovery may run two expensive operations concurrently while weighted admission preserves provider and identity progress within the existing 24-connection pool.

Under DNS quota pressure, uncovered eligible servers precede additional endpoint allocation to already covered servers. Publication still requires current ownership, routing, transport and TLS evidence.

Readiness rejects disabled checksums, active recovery alarms and backup verification receipts older than 26 hours. Daily backup reuse requires the same sealed generation to be verified and less than 20 hours old; directory mtime cannot extend its lifetime.
Fresh installation uses an independently owned checksum-enabled cluster. Existing database identities remain authoritative; no automatic in-place checksum rewrite of unrelated or existing clusters.
evidence_location: Exact-commit source and installation results are attached through GitHub Actions. Production preservation evidence is recorded separately in private operations reports.
